title: Reusable crate returns
bodyMd:
Crates were issued at three depots. Returned crates are a subset of those issued during the measured cycle, with no returns from earlier cycles.

| Category | Issued crates | Returned crates |
|---|---:|---:|
| Hill | 100 | 88 |
| Market | 150 | 120 |
| River | 250 | 225 |
